title: engine:F4 — Canonical spellbook-copy execution and asset-cost ownership
description:
Resolve wizard spellbook copying as ONE provider-neutral procedure spanning spell
eligibility, elapsed time, and currency/asset mutation.

ROOT CAUSE: spellbook primitives and currency primitives exist separately in
@eshyra/core, but no single procedure owns the complete copying contract, so the
cost, the time, the eligibility check, and the retained asset mutation cannot be
executed as one transaction. The source clause defines them together; the engine
splits them apart and therefore cannot execute any of them faithfully.

LEDGER ROW: capabilityId engine:F4, primitive
"spellbook-copy-cost-and-asset-ledger".
Pack membership: records whose data.executionReadiness hooks qualify as
engine:F4 with wizard spellbook copying semantics. Compare against the source
clause's economy and asset requirements rather than against the family row.

CROSSES: engine:F10 (currency and retained assets) and engine:F7 (elapsed time).
engine:F4 owns it; F10 and F7 supply primitives.

REQUIRED INVARIANT: copying either completes as a single atomic procedure with
eligibility, time, cost, and the resulting retained asset all applied, or it
fails closed with no partial mutation. A partially-applied copy is the defect.

PROVENANCE: this bead exists because the bootstrap capability ledger
(eshyra-o9bd.19.5.1, PR #477) found this primitive had NO owner in the current
family decomposition. It was recorded there as ownershipStatus=proposed-new-bead;
this bead is that proposal made real, and the ledger row now points here.

CROSS-FAMILY PRIMITIVE. The owning family is named in the title, but the
requirement crosses family boundaries. Per the authorization criteria on
eshyra-olc5.1, a cross-family primitive is named ONCE and assigned ONE owning
family — do not re-implement it under the families it touches. Coordinate
instead.

SEQUENCING: this bead is blocked by its family's decomposition task and must not
be started before it. Decomposition does not RE-CREATE this bead; it reconciles
against it, decides whether the primitive splits further, and names the
conformance scenarios. Duplicating it under a sibling family is the failure mode
to avoid.

GREEN BAR: the nine-point definition on eshyra-o9bd.19 applies — this primitive
is not done until a provider-neutral implementation exists, reference-engine
conformance tests exercise the committed PACK representation (not a fixture),
tool exposure and state mutation are correct, unsupported input fails CLOSED,
and replay / deterministic equivalence holds where applicable.

COUNT HYGIENE: membership comes from the ledger's generated query for this
primitive. Never hand-copy a hook count into an acceptance test.

*** engine:F* IS A QUALIFIED PREFIX. engine:F1..F10 are the pack's
executionReadiness engineHooks families — NOT the CLOSED epic eshyra-2n1t's
different F1-F10, and NOT the fable:F1..F8 audit findings.
acceptance_criteria:
• A single provider-neutral spellbook-copy procedure owns eligibility, elapsed time, cost, and retained-asset mutation.
• Cost and asset mutation are transactional with the eligibility check; no partial application is reachable.
• Conformance tests drive the procedure from the committed pack representation, not a fixture.
• Unsupported or ambiguous source input fails CLOSED.
• The engine:F4 ledger membership query returns zero unowned clauses for this primitive.
